verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a per-jurisdiction nexus position with economic thresholds and current sales and transaction counts, plus MCP access to filings and transactions. It also claims continuous monitoring of tax exposure across jurisdictions. That gives a jurisdiction-level view of where liability exists, but nothing shows accrued tax amounts or reconciliation of collected versus owed. Missing for 10: accrued liability dollar amounts by jurisdiction, a collected-vs-owed reconciliation view, filing-ready return detail, accountant/GL-consumable exports or accounting integrations, and independent corroboration.
